name: Lynn
bio: A relentless combatant who masters greatsword and dual pistols, focused on close-to-mid range offense and mechanical augmentation — one of the more balanced DPS units.

skills.name: Deadly Blossom
skills.desc: Deals Pyro Damage to enemies in front and inflicts [Laceration].

skills.name: Gunpowder Revelry
skills.desc: Switches the ranged weapon to [Hansel and Gretel]. In this state, Lynn can shoot and use skills, but cannot move. Shooting deals damage to all enemies in front, during which Lynn gains 1 stack that increases Lynn's ATK Speed every 0.2s, up to 35 stacks. Using [Hansel and Gretel] continuously consumes Sanity, during which Lynn is immune to Hitstun when taking damage. When Sanity drops to 0 or the skill is used again, sheathes [Hansel and Gretel].

skills.name: Tactical Rapid Fire
skills.desc: When not shooting, Lynn gains 1 [Preload] stack per second, up to 6 stacks. When shooting, consumes all [Preload] stacks to gain [Suppressing Fire] for a period of time. [Suppressing Fire]: Increases the damage based on the number of the consumed [Preload] stacks. Cannot gain [Preload] stack during [Suppressing Fire].

skills.name: The Unforgivable
skills.desc: Immediately removes [Laceration] and deals damage once the [Lacerated Wound] count reaches its maximum.

skills.name: Hellforge
skills.desc: [Only effective when deployed as a Combat Partner] Increases ATK for the character and their nearby Pyro teammate(s).
